title: What Really Happens When You Crack Your Knuckles

scenes.say: One doctor cracked his knuckles for sixty years, on just one hand. On purpose.
Everyone's heard it: cracking your knuckles gives you arthritis.
scenes.heading: THE WARNING

scenes.say: So what is that pop? Your joints sit in a fluid. When you stretch the joint, a gas bubble forms inside it.
scenes.heading: THE POP

scenes.say: That's also why you can't crack the same knuckle again right away.
Doctor Donald Unger tested the myth on himself. He cracked his left hand at least twice a day, and never his right.
scenes.heading: THE EXPERIMENT

scenes.say: After about sixty years, he compared them.
scenes.label: left hand vs right hand

scenes.say: Neither hand had arthritis. And the study won him an Ig Nobel Prize.
scenes.heading: THE RESULT
